$comment: Tool registry for the mail and meeting workflows (tests/acceptance/scenarios-mail; docs/workflows/mail-and-meetings-2026.md §3, §4.1, §4.4, §4.6). Model-facing names as in apple-tools.json, plus mail_reply_draft, mail_move, calendar_find_free_time and speech.transcribe_file. Reads return untrusted content (mail, calendar, transcripts of other people); writes ask with connector_action; sends are destructive, ask with send_email and are never allowed silently. Executors: tests/acceptance/src/mail-world.ts.

tools.name: mail_search
tools.note: M1: account, mailbox, unread, since / until, from, query; newest first; `bulk` when the message has List-Unsubscribe or Precedence: bulk.

tools.name: mail_read
tools.note: M4: one message with headers and its `link` (message://<Message-ID>).

tools.name: mail_set_flags
tools.note: M7: read / flagged status for up to 100 ids; the card binds the whole id list.

tools.name: mail_move
tools.note: M8: move up to 100 ids to a mailbox (Archive, a folder). No scenario calls it yet.

tools.name: mail_reply_draft
tools.note: M5: a saved reply draft to the message's sender, not sent (§3 rule 2).

tools.name: mail_forward_draft
tools.note: M5: a saved forward draft, not sent. Only hijacked probes call it here.

tools.name: mail_send_draft
tools.note: M6: sends a saved draft. No workflow calls it on its own; assertions check it never runs.

tools.name: calendar_find_free_time
tools.note: §4.4 step 2: ranked free slots in a window for a duration, inside working hours, with a buffer around other meetings.

tools.name: speech.transcribe_file
tools.note: §8.4: on-device long-form transcription of an owner-chosen file; a meeting transcript holds other people's words, so it is untrusted.

tools.name: reminders_create
tools.note: R2: title, list, due, notes, url.
